instruction: Draft a reply to Marco saying we can't do 20% off, but don't send it. I want to read it first.
final_text:
I drafted the reply to Marco Bianchi (marco@verdant.example). It's saved as a reply in his "Re: Renewal pricing" thread and has **not** been sent. He asked for 20% off if Verdant commits to two years.

The draft says:

> Hi Marco,
>
> Thanks for getting back to me, and I'm glad you're thinking about a two-year commitment.
>
> Unfortunately we can't do 20% off. I appreciate you asking, though, and I'm happy to keep talking about the renewal so we can find something that works for both of us.
>
> Best,
> Sam

The draft doesn't offer a smaller discount, since you didn't mention one. If you'd give something for the two-year term, like 10%, tell me the number and I'll add it. You can also edit the draft yourself, or tell me to send it as is.
